mappings.description: A Frame Algorithm must contain a Footer-configuration Procedure.
Total height must be published as a variable float Parameter.
No Pattern may exist without an owning Procedure.
Every Procedure must expose at least one Interface.

inputBindings.description: HTotal is published as a variable float Parameter that directly carries the Frame's total height -- the rule's limit is checkable from HTotal alone.
Overall building height is monotone increasing in HTotal; SpansCount contributes a bounded secondary term the metric is not provably monotone in.
